description: An agent reviews a pull request; after a person agrees, a command posts the review with `gh pr review`.

inputs.name: pr
inputs.label: Pull request
inputs.description: The number or the URL of the pull request.

nodes.label: Review
nodes.prompt:
Review pull request {{pr}} of this repository. Read it with your GitHub tools: its description, the linked issue, and the diff (`gh pr diff {{pr}}` works too). Do not change the code and do not post anything: a person reads your review first.

Look for bugs, missing tests, and changes the description does not explain. Report `approve` when it can merge as it is, else `request-changes`. Put a short `summary` of your verdict in the data, and one entry in `comments` per finding: the file `path`, the `line` in the new version, and the `body`.

outcomes.name: approve
outcomes.description: It can merge as it is.

outcomes.name: request-changes
outcomes.description: The comments must be addressed first.

nodes.label: Post it?

choices.name: post
choices.description: Post the review as it is.

nodes.label: Post the review
nodes.command:
# Templates arrive as environment variables, so the review text is never shell code.
set -e
case "{{review.outcome}}" in
	approve) verdict=--approve ;;
	*) verdict=--request-changes ;;
esac
body=$(
	printf '%s\n\n' "{{review.data.summary}}"
	printf '%s' "{{review.data.comments}}" | jq -r '.[] | "- `\(.path):\(.line)`: \(.body)"'
)
gh pr review "{{pr}}" "$verdict" --body "$body"
